findings.message: The plot x-axis is fixed at 0–5 s and the y-axis at ±11 m/s, while the ruler runs 0–13.2 m. The fast toss at the top (2.5 s, 12.5 m) sits inside both ranges. The plot has no drawn marker object in the frame, so the linked marker can't be checked from the frames.

Check at 0.41 s: v = 5 − 9.8×0.410204 = 0.98 m/s, and the height is 1.2265 m. The ruler scale is 175 px per 13.2 m, so the ball should rise about 16.3 px. It is drawn at y = 226.74, which is 16.26 px up, so this is consistent. The v arrow length is 11.76 px, so the arrow scale is 12 px per m/s. This is consistent.
